summary: Lantronix filed an 8-K regarding a firm-commitment underwritten public offering of 4,166,667 common shares at $7.20 per share, plus a fully exercised 30-day option for 625,000 additional shares. Needham & Company and Canaccord Genuity acted as underwriters. Net proceeds of ~$32.3 million will be used for working capital and strategic growth initiatives, including unmanned systems development. The offering closed on June 1, 2026. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation; there is no merger, tender offer, or strategic change to analyse.
